# Citation Intent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CitationIntent`](gmeow-CitationIntent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CitationIntent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The intent with which one entity cites another — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) characterizing a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md). Bridged by reference to CiTO sub-properties (e.g. [cito:citesAsDataSource](http://purl.org/spar/cito/citesAsDataSource)). The set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CitationIntent`](gmeow-CitationIntent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for citation intent — referenced from a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](gmeow-CitationAct.md) via [`gmeow:citationIntent`](../properties/gmeow-citationIntent.md), or extended with a new individual when a CiTO-style intent not yet seeded is needed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a subclass for a new intent (intents are individuals on an open vocabulary) and avoid using it where the contribution's weight, not the citation's purpose, is meant — that is [`gmeow:ContributionDegree`](gmeow-ContributionDegree.md).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded gmeow:intent* individual from [`gmeow:citationIntent`](../properties/gmeow-citationIntent.md); extend by minting a new individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and [skos:definition](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition), aligned to a CiTO sub-property by reference ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)) rather than imported as axioms.

### Examples

- ex:intent a [`gmeow:CitationIntent`](gmeow-CitationIntent.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "refutes"@en.
